title: PostgreSQL 18 Tutorial (Part I)
why: Hands-on first CREATE/INSERT/SELECT trace, join and aggregate walkthroughs, and a short transaction tutorial that match the early SQLite/PostgreSQL sandbox labs.

title: PostgreSQL 18, Part II: The SQL Language
why: Authoritative reference for value types and casts, DDL constraints and foreign keys, joins, aggregates, subqueries, CTEs, window functions and NULL expression semantics.

title: SQL As Understood by SQLite
why: Syntax reference for the SQLite CLI and Python stdlib labs, covering SELECT, joins, aggregates, WITH clauses, window functions and transactions.

title: Database System Concepts, 7th edition: author's slides
version: 7th edition slide index, chapter decks updated Jan-Mar 2019 (index read 2026-10-19)
why: Free author decks for every chapter, including ch. 7 Relational Database Design (functional dependencies, 3NF) and ch. 17 Transactions and ch. 18 Concurrency Control (two-phase locking).

title: Go standard library: database/sql
why: Authoritative reference for DB/Tx/Rows/Stmt ownership, connection pooling, context cancellation and error handling in Go database clients.

title: Avoiding SQL injection risk (Go documentation)
why: Shows the parameter-binding boundary that prevents injection and the unsafe fmt.Sprintf string-assembly alternative.

title: pgx: PostgreSQL driver and toolkit for Go (v5)
why: Pinned driver documentation for the later Go labs: connection configuration and pooling, prepared statements, transactions and row scanning.

title: Database System Concepts
why: Canonical textbook treatment of functional dependencies, normalization to third normal form, schema design and ACID transaction foundations.
